newsitem.title: USA: Envirodyne panel finds offer unacceptable.
newsitem.headline: Envirodyne panel finds offer unacceptable.

text.p: Envirodyne Industries Inc said Monday that its independent committee of the board found an offer from HK Acquisitions to purchase the company was unacceptable and not in the best interests of stockholders.
As previously reported, Envirodyne received an offer from HK Acquisitions to acquire it for $8.50 a share in cash, subject to a definitive merger agreement.

The HK offer included a proposal that, if Envirodyne agreed to be acquired and then called off the deal due to an alternative transaction, it would be obligated to pay HK Acquisitions a $10 million fee.
Envirodyne has interests in food packaging and the food supplies industry. Its three subsidiaries are Viskase Corp, Clear Shield National Inc and Sandusky Plastics Inc.
